title.zh: Audited DeFi protocols lost $885M to attacks that occurred completely outside their audit scopes
title.en: Audited DeFi protocols lost $885M to attacks that occurred completely outside their audit scopes

current_state.zh: A preprint analyzing 135 DeFi incidents in H1 2026 finds that 46 of 68 audited protocols' attack paths fell entirely outside their audit scopes, accounting for $885M in losses.
